additional_info.subject: RE: 0390143 - ID0390143-DC/Si-D/CZ-[MP / R3 170001597] charging cable temperature sensor error CRM:02023000310
additional_info.body:
Dear Tomas,
I hope all is well with you. Thank you so much for your support during the last-day intervention. Please be aware that I have completed analysis on this charger for the last month and understand there is an issue with the DC2 connector. Out of 39 charging sessions, approx. 10 of them are interrupting with cable temperature plausibility errors. It is clear from our yesterday's intervention that there is a mechanical issue with the connector, which is leading to the error. Observed cable temperature varies with applying an external force to cable. Found temperature value jumped to 123 degrees C while gently applying the twisting force. As this cannot be repaired at site, I am requesting to initiate the procurement process for a new connector and replace the damaged one with a new ASAP.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sambath.K.S
